name: front-m4
description: Re-seat the forward corner screw. The corner bracket's forward M4 screw into the post T-slot has worked loose. Everything else is tight and the rail is level. Tighten that screw with the yellow 3 mm/0.60 N m driver until it clicks. Leave the other screws tight, the rail level and the reference flag home with the sensor detecting it, after releasing the stand.
